title: Google’s $899 Googlebook is a bet that you’ll buy a new laptop for Gemini
summary: Google’s AI-native Googlebook ties Gemini to the cursor, dictation, widgets and other parts of the desktop experience.
title_es: Google lanza Googlebook, laptop con Gemini integrado
bajada: Google presenta Googlebook a $899, una laptop diseñada nativamente para IA que integra Gemini en el cursor, dictado y widgets del escritorio. Es la apuesta de Google en hardware para impulsar la adopción de IA.
bajada_en: Google launches Googlebook at $899, an AI-native laptop integrating Gemini into the cursor, dictation, and desktop widgets. It's Google's hardware bet to drive AI adoption.

title: UN says AI safeguards can’t wait for certainty
summary: Governments need to rein in increasingly capable AI agents before their risks are fully understood, a United Nations scientific panel warned in the global organization's first major assessment of OpenAI's hack of Hugging Face earlier this year. The report cements AI's place on the global diplomatic agenda this week as leaders gather in New York […]
title_es: ONU: regulación de IA no puede esperar certeza total
bajada: Un panel científico de la ONU advierte que gobiernos deben regular agentes IA cada vez más capaces antes de comprender completamente sus riesgos. El reporte posiciona IA como prioridad diplomática global.
bajada_en: A UN scientific panel warns that governments must regulate increasingly capable AI agents before fully understanding their risks. The report cements AI as a global diplomatic priority.

title: Building standards for the next phase of AI
summary: OpenAI outlines a path to shared global AI standards, calling for coordinated evaluation, reporting, and governance to improve safety.
title_es: OpenAI propone estándares globales para IA
bajada: OpenAI presenta un plan para establecer estándares compartidos en evaluación, reportes y gobernanza de IA a nivel mundial. La iniciativa busca mejorar la seguridad mediante coordinación internacional entre gobiernos y empresas.
bajada_en: OpenAI presents a plan to establish shared standards in AI evaluation, reporting, and governance globally. The initiative aims to improve safety through international coordination between governments and companies.

title: How V7 gives AI agents institutional memory
summary: Using GPT-5.6, V7 turns scattered company files into context agents can use to complete complex, source-linked work.
title_es: V7: Memoria institucional para agentes IA
bajada: V7 aprovecha GPT-5.6 para convertir archivos dispersos de empresas en contexto que agentes IA pueden usar. La herramienta permite que los agentes completen trabajos complejos vinculados a fuentes originales.
bajada_en: V7 leverages GPT-5.6 to turn scattered company files into context that AI agents can use. The tool enables agents to complete complex, source-linked work within organizations.

title: Why Deploying Physical AI at Scale Demands Safety at Every Layer
summary: Physical AI is moving rapidly from research to large-scale deployment. By 2035, ABI Research projects an installed base of 49 million level 3-5 autonomous vehicles (AVs), while Omdia estimates that roughly 60 million industrial robots will be deployed between 2026 and 2035. As these machines enter roads, factories, warehouses and other environments shared with people, […]
title_es: IA física a escala requiere seguridad en cada capa
bajada: NVIDIA alerta sobre el despliegue masivo de IA física: se proyectan 49 millones de vehículos autónomos y 60 millones de robots industriales para 2035. La seguridad en cada capa es crítica ante máquinas compartiendo espacios con personas.
bajada_en: NVIDIA highlights massive physical AI deployment: 49 million autonomous vehicles and 60 million industrial robots projected by 2035. Safety at every layer is critical as machines share spaces with people.

title: The Real Cost of AI: A Survey of the Unpredictable Token Economics
summary: For decades, enterprise software budgeting was a predictable exercise: negotiate a subscription fee, project the number of seats you need, move on. AI has broken that model. Pricing tied to tokens — the metered unit behind most AI billing — has turned technology spend into a variable cost, and an unpredictable one.The Information’s survey of 107 of our readers  - senior leaders and professionals (See Methodology) - finds that most companies haven’t gotten a handle on it: 60% say the cost trajectory of their AI initiatives is unpredictable, at the exact moment CFOs, boards and investors are demanding proof of ROI.60%: “The cost trajectory of AI initiatives is unpredictable.”This piece draws on that survey and The Information’s Deep Research to examine where AI budgets are actually going, why token costs remain so hard to forecast, and what separates the companies that have managed AI spending from those still being surprised by their bills.The Bulk of the AI BudgetOutside the hyperscalers, who arepouring billions into data centers, most companies put the bulk of their AI investment — 64% — into software, applications, and API models. (See Chart.) That reflects where ROI is actually realized, according to The Information: most businesses want solutions to specific problems, not infrastructure to manage.This 64% budget line includes the unpredictability factor, the token, which behaves unlike anything else in the technology budget.Let’s unpack the costs of different types of software. The classic subscription/SaaS model relies on per-seat licenses for enterprise systems of record and the cloud services that underpin them, such as CRM (Salesforce), ERP/HR and finance (SAP, Workday), and collaboration (Slack).Packaged AI apps and assistants, like ChatGPT or Microsoft Copilot, are also largely bought per seat. The flat seat price covers token usage but also limits what an AI assistant can do. The main drawback of seat-based licensing has always been waste: many paid seats
title_es: El costo impredecible de IA: economía de tokens
bajada: Una encuesta de The Information muestra que 60% de empresas no controlan el costo de sus iniciativas IA, debido a la variabilidad de precios basados en tokens. La incertidumbre dificulta justificar ROI ante CFOs e inversores.
bajada_en: The Information survey shows 60% of companies struggle to predict AI initiative costs due to unpredictable token-based pricing. The uncertainty makes it hard to justify ROI to CFOs and investors.

title: OpenAI Develops Features to Counter Grok Bot, Mulls Response to Meta’s Muse
summary: OpenAIpioneered AI that can take over web browsers and other applications on people’s behalf, and itsChatGPTapp brought generative AI to consumers. Now that rivals likeSpaceXandMetaare pushing the boundaries by launching personal AI agents that handle multistep tasks, OpenAI is playing catch-up.For instance, OpenAI is developing features to compete more directly with SpaceX’s recently launchedGrok Bot, which helps customers create always-on AI “teammates” to handle routine tasks, manage software, and collaborate in the background, according to a person with knowledge of the effort. OpenAI also has discussed developing a personal AI assistant to compete with one that Meta Platforms recently launched, according to another person with knowledge of the situation.In developing such products, OpenAI would be repurposing and rebranding some of the existing “agentic” technology it already offers throughCodexand ChatGPT. Some customers of these OpenAI apps have already connected them to their email, calendar and other applications so they can automate tasks such as scheduling appointments or communicating with businesses by email, sometimes over multiple days.
title_es: OpenAI desarrolla features contra Grok y Muse
bajada: OpenAI está desarrollando características para competir con Grok Bot de SpaceX y el asistente personal de Meta. La compañía reutilizará tecnología agentic existente para responder a competidores en agentes IA personales.
bajada_en: OpenAI is developing features to compete with SpaceX's Grok Bot and Meta's personal AI assistant. The company will repurpose existing agentic technology to respond to personal AI agent competitors.

title: Meta’s AI agent has been blocked from using Amazon.com
summary: Muse isn't welcome as a shopper anymore.
title_es: Amazon bloquea agente IA Muse de Meta
bajada: Amazon ha bloqueado a Muse, el agente IA de Meta, de usar su plataforma de compras. El movimiento refleja tensiones entre grandes tech sobre qué agentes IA pueden acceder a servicios.
bajada_en: Amazon has blocked Meta's AI agent Muse from using its shopping platform. The move reflects tensions between tech giants over AI agent access to services.

title: Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence
summary: OpenAI is working with an independent Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence to guide the review and communication of emerging AI results.
title_es: OpenAI crea grupo asesor para matemáticas e IA
bajada: OpenAI forma un Grupo Asesor Independiente en Matemáticas e IA para revisar y comunicar resultados emergentes. El equipo ayudará a guiar la investigación y validación de nuevos hallazgos en el campo.
bajada_en: OpenAI establishes an independent Advisory Group on Mathematics and AI to review and communicate emerging results. The group will guide research validation and communication of new findings.

title: AI Security Is an Engineering Problem — How to Solve It at Every Layer of the Agent Stack
summary: AI security is an engineering problem. That means defined security requirements, enforceable controls, named owners and evidence that protections work.  As AI becomes more capable, the industry must accelerate security engineering, broaden access to defensive tools and share what works faster.  Technology Changes, Security Fundamentals Endure The internet and cloud computing changed how software operates, […]
title_es: NVIDIA: seguridad IA como problema de ingeniería
bajada: NVIDIA propone abordar la seguridad de IA como un problema de ingeniería definido con requisitos, controles y propietarios claros. El enfoque busca acelerar la ingeniería defensiva y compartir soluciones más rápido.
bajada_en: NVIDIA proposes treating AI security as an engineering problem with defined requirements, enforceable controls, and clear ownership. The approach aims to accelerate defensive engineering and faster knowledge sharing.

title: OpenAI and Anthropic Neared Deal to Stress-Test Each Other’s AI
summary: OpenAIis rethinking a range of safety strategies as it responds to fears from employees and others about the dangers its AI poses. One solution could lie in the recent past.Even before the spate of cybersecurity incidents involving OpenAI’s technology and the dire warnings from industry workers, the company was negotiating a legally binding deal withAnthropicfor the companies to stress-test each other’s models, according to a person with direct knowledge of the discussions, which haven’t been previously reported.
title_es: OpenAI y Anthropic casi cierran acuerdo de stress-test
bajada: OpenAI y Anthropic estuvieron negociando un acuerdo vinculante para que mutuamente prueben y validen sus modelos IA. La iniciativa responde a preocupaciones de seguridad y fue considerada antes de recientes incidentes de ciberseguridad.
bajada_en: OpenAI and Anthropic nearly reached a binding deal to stress-test each other's AI models. The initiative addresses safety concerns and was considered before recent cybersecurity incidents.

title: tokenizers v1: encode, decode and scaling, measured
bajada: Hugging Face presenta tokenizers v1 con mejoras en codificación, decodificación y medición de escalabilidad. La herramienta es fundamental para developers que trabajan con LLMs.
bajada_en: Hugging Face releases tokenizers v1 with improvements in encoding, decoding, and scalability measurement. The tool is essential for developers working with LLMs.

title: Pruning LLMs Like a Physicist: Block Removal as an Ising Optimization Problem
title_es: Pruning de LLMs usando física: optimización Ising
bajada: Hugging Face presenta un método para podar LLMs inspirado en física, modelando la remoción de bloques como problema de optimización Ising. El enfoque ofrece una nueva perspectiva para reducir tamaño de modelos.
bajada_en: Hugging Face presents an LLM pruning method inspired by physics, modeling block removal as an Ising optimization problem. The approach offers a novel perspective for model size reduction.

title: Got an Android Phone? Google Thinks You’ll Probably Want a Googlebook Laptop
summary: Apple lovers have long enjoyed seamless connectivity between their iPhones and Macs. Now, Google’s bringing that experience to Android.
title_es: Google presenta Googlebook: Android se conecta con hardware
bajada: Google lanza laptops Googlebook que integran experiencias similares a las que ofrece Apple entre iPhone y Mac. La estrategia busca aprovechar el ecosistema Android en el mercado de computadoras.
bajada_en: Google launches Googlebook laptops offering seamless integration similar to iPhone-Mac connectivity. The strategy aims to leverage the Android ecosystem in the computer market.

title: Expanding OpenAI Academy with new learning paths
summary: Explore new OpenAI Academy learning paths for employees, developers, leaders, educators, and students to build and demonstrate practical AI skills.
title_es: OpenAI expande Academy con nuevas rutas
bajada: OpenAI presenta nuevas rutas de aprendizaje en OpenAI Academy para empleados, developers, líderes, educadores y estudiantes. La iniciativa busca democratizar habilidades prácticas de IA.
bajada_en: OpenAI expands Academy with new learning paths for employees, developers, leaders, educators, and students. The initiative aims to democratize practical AI skills.
